bullets.sentence: Diamond headwinds contracted economic activity by 3 percent in 2024, widening the fiscal deficit to 7.1 percent of GDP and prompting sovereign rating downgrades by S&P and Moody's.
With net debt projected to exceed 40 percent of GDP by end-FY25/26, staff recommends consolidating 4.7 ppts of GDP over three years to keep public debt under 50 percent of GDP.

To stem reserve declines and address an estimated 10.5 percent exchange rate overvaluation, staff urges increasing the policy rate from 1.9 percent toward its interest rate parity level of about 7.5 percent.

Financial sector oversight is advancing as the Banking Act 2023 commenced on 15 August 2025 for consolidated supervision, alongside Liquidity Coverage Ratio guidelines set for implementation on 1 December 2025.

High-impact conjunctural risks threatening the baseline include falling global rough diamond prices, delayed fiscal consolidation, and impaired monetary policy transmission amid liquidity stress and depleted fiscal buffers.
